authRecovery.expiredTitle: Sign-in expired. Your input is still here.
authRecovery.expired: Your input is kept in this tab. Do not refresh or close it. Sign in again in a new tab, then return here and save manually. Your previous changes will not be retried automatically.
authRecovery.signIn: Sign in again in a new tab
authRecovery.restored: You can save again. Review your input and submit it manually. No previous operation has been replayed automatically.

settings.title: Site settings
settings.intro: Manage site identity, the home introduction, footer, appearance, and search and sharing information. All changes require an explicit save.
settings.previewHint: Choosing a preset, font size or color only changes this preview. It does not save other inputs or affect public pages. Save to apply changes.
settings.imageHint: Choose an image authorized for this site. Leave empty to omit it.
settings.defaultThemeHint: Used only when the visitor has not chosen an appearance. Saved visitor preferences are not replaced.
settings.localeHint: The URL determines the language: / for Chinese and /en/ for English. This legacy default_locale value is retained for compatibility and does not override the URL:
settings.seoHint: Page titles and descriptions from page management take priority. These site values fill missing fields. Only a configured sharing image is published; leave empty to omit it.
settings.loadedError: Settings could not be loaded. Saving is disabled to avoid overwriting the site with defaults. Please reload.
settings.saveError: Could not save. Your input is still here; review it and try again.
settings.saved: Settings saved. Public pages use the new configuration on their next load.

hints.site_title: Shown in navigation and used as the browser title when both page and SEO titles are missing.
hints.project_title: Shown as the home introduction and used for banner alternative text. It does not replace the person's name in the CMS.
hints.footer_text: Shown as entered at the bottom of every page. Empty means omitted; personal details are not added automatically.
hints.logo_url: Shown beside the site name in navigation. Empty means the name alone.
hints.banner_url: Only the configured image is shown, on the home page. Empty means no banner.

pages.title: Page management
pages.intro: Manage page structure, navigation and page descriptions.
pages.homeProtection: Home is the site entry point and cannot be hidden or deleted. Its title and description can still be edited.
pages.newHint: Under the current design, new pages are public once saved. Make sure the title and description are ready to publish. Editing an existing hidden page does not publish it.
pages.slugHint: The path cannot be changed after creation. Descriptions are used for search and sharing.
pages.discard: Discard your unsaved changes and close?
pages.confirmDelete: Delete “{title}” and all its sections? This cannot be undone.
pages.loadError: Pages could not be loaded. Creating and saving are disabled. Please retry.
pages.saveError: Could not save. Your input is still here.
pages.reorderError: Could not reorder. The original order has been restored.
pages.required: Enter a path and a Chinese title.
